correctness.rationale: All possible completions on the old carrier are exactly permutations of labelled directed path components. A cycle has odd vertex length iff it contains an odd number of odd-size components; even blocks can be deleted and reinserted into a and then a+1 etc gaps, giving the exact multiplicity. Original closed cycles persist. A single new singleton path makes the all-even-path case feasible with exactly b! completions, proving optimality. Standalone checker exhaustively tests all 1546 partial maps on size five and all relevant one-new-vertex instances on size four.
